newsitem.title: USA: Casino Data and Intl Gaming in deal.
newsitem.headline: Casino Data and Intl Gaming in deal.

text.p: Casino Data Systems and International Game Technology said Tuesday that they have executed a multi-faceted agreement resolving various business and technological matters. The agreement includes, among other undisclosed terms, exchanges of technology and release of claims as well as payment of an undisclosed sum by IGT to CDS.
In exchange for CDS and Summit (and its related companies) granting back to IGT all their respective rights under the Telnaes patent, IGT has granted CDS a full license under the Telnaes patent.

The agreement between CDS and IGT also includes a mutual release of claims arising from the re-employment by IGT of six management level employees who previously executed employment agreements with CDS and who later returned to employment with IGT.

Steven Weiss, CDS chairman and chief executive,said, "The agreement on the various matters between our companies allow CDS to continue its focus on current and future business opportunities. We have always preferred reasonable business solutions. We are also confident that this agreement lays a framework for relations between our companies."

G. Thomas Baker, IGT president and chief operating officer, said, "IGT is pleased to have reduced the number of outstanding licenses under the Telnaes patent and at the same time to avoid future litigation with CDS and Summit (and its related companies) relating to its rights under the Telnaes patent. Also, the re-employment of the IGT executives will not be the subject of a future dispute."
